## Decision

Only hook registrations that both have a gw hook implementation and a green corpus-parity scenario move to gw hook <name>. Today that is 9 of 16 registrations. spec-guard, deslop-guard, prose-negation-guard, prose-modality-guard, doc-read-guard, doc-size-guard and keyword-router have no gw hook implementation and MUST NOT be rewired.

## Rationale

Verified in source: src/gw/hook/index.ts registers exactly stop-gate, session-reminder, nesting-guard, agent-model-guard, orchestrator-impl-guard, ledger-guard, ledger-bash-guard, piped-exit-code-guard, struggle-detector. hooks/hooks.json registers 16 commands. Rewiring a name with no gw implementation would make the hook fail or no-op silently. Rollback stays one step because hooks/hooks.json is the only file the rewire slice touches. Supersedes the mis-numbered append made earlier this session (2026-09-01T06:29Z) which collided with an existing decision id; that event is void.

## Alternatives Considered

- Port the seven missing hooks first, then rewire all 16 at once
- Rewire nothing until the whole hook set is ported
